help:
Usage: friday-chat [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                 
                                                                                
 FridayV2 chat application. Runtime features are implemented incrementally from 
 the FridayV2 planning packet.                                                  
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version                           Show the FridayV2 package version and    │
│                                     exit.                                    │
│ --replay                    <path>  Replay an exported transcript CSV and    │
│                                     exit.                                    │
│ --replay-delay              <str>   Delay in seconds between replayed user   │
│                                     turns.                                   │
│ --config                    <path>  Load Friday-py-style YAML config and     │
│                                     start the interactive chat.              │
│ --cli-config                <path>  Load Friday CLI display configuration.   │
│ --runtime                   <str>   Runtime mode for --config startup: fake  │
│                                     or real.                                 │
│                                     [default: fake]                          │
│ --install-completion                Install completion for the current       │
│                                     shell.                                   │
│ --show-completion                   Show completion for the current shell,   │
│                                     to copy it or customize the              │
│                                     installation.                            │
│ --help                              Show this message and exit.              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
